release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD4667T-25A4/W is a battery-powered, magnetically-mounted bi-spectrum portable thermal PTZ camera with a 640x512 VOx thermal detector (25 mm lens) and a 4 MP 25x optical zoom channel. It offers temperature measurement (-20 to 550 C), fire detection, GPS, Wi-Fi and 4G, two-way audio and 10+ hours of battery runtime. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1 (Streaming/Channels/101), thermal is Channel 2 (Streaming/Channels/201).
